description: Record cash put into the tin, in whole MINOR units, with the date and source, and return the new balance against the imprest. It also reimburses every voucher up to that date, as a replenishment does.

amount_minor.description: Cash added, in whole minor units

date.description: The date the cash went in, YYYY-MM-DD

float.description: The float id, e.g. FLOAT-2026-0001, or its name. Omit when there is only one

source.description: Where it came from, e.g. Cheque 0142, Bank withdrawal, or Owner

name: topup_record
title: Record cash put into the float
